authorityCeiling.basis: The paper states AXON routes events across active, permitted edges and emits route receipts, and that AXON cannot bypass authority or evidence contracts. Routing is not one of the Section 3.3 authority levels, and the paper assigns no authority level to AXON, so no level is claimed.

Role quote: "Routes events across active, permitted edges; emits route receipts." Boundary quote: "AXON cannot bypass authority or evidence contracts." Neither assigns a Section 3.3 authority level to routing.

capabilityFamilies.basis: Role quote: "Routes events across active, permitted edges; emits route receipts."

lifecycleStages.basis: Section 3.3 defines lifecycleMask as workflow stage and completion state but names no stages. The paper assigns no lifecycle stages to AXON.

memoryPlanes.basis: The paper assigns no memory planes to AXON. Route receipts are emitted, not stored by AXON; storage belongs to PMLA / Vault.

outputClasses.basis: Role quote: "emits route receipts." A route receipt is a recorded artifact.

permittedRoutes.basis: The paper defines routeMask semantics in Sections 3.2 and 3.3 but names no per-organ routes for AXON. AXON routes across permitted edges; the edges themselves are not enumerated.

paperBoundary: AXON cannot bypass authority or evidence contracts.
paperRole: Routes events across active, permitted edges; emits route receipts.
paperSource: N-Cell position paper, Section 4 mapping table, https://ncell-position-paper.pages.dev/, accessed 2026-11-14.
